recorded_scope: Read-only host availability before W1 validation freeze and execution. No jobs launched by this sample.

call.cmd:
python -B - <<'PY'
import json,os
from pathlib import Path
memory={line.split(':')[0]:line.split(':')[1].strip() for line in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines() if line.split(':')[0] in ('MemTotal','MemAvailable','SwapTotal','SwapFree')}
print(json.dumps({'affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'memory':memory}))
PY
call.justification: Inspect host CPU and memory availability to schedule the authorized W1 validation jobs.
